name: Tones on Tail
label: Beggars Banquet
lede: Daniel Ash started it in a flat with the Bauhaus roadie, Kevin Haskins joined when Bauhaus died, and in three years the trio made one album, toured America in white suits, and left 'Go!' to the dance floors.

eras.title: A side project in the flat
eras.text: While still in Bauhaus, Daniel Ash started recording with Glenn Campling, an art school friend, flatmate and Bauhaus roadie. Campling has called it a bedroom and studio project before it was ever a live band.

years.src: Wikipedia: Tones on Tail · Torched: Fan questions
years.h: Ash and his flatmate name a band after tape leader
years.p: The name refers to calibration tones recorded on the tail of a reel-to-reel tape. Campling plays bass; both handle percussion and keyboards.

years.h: The Tones on Tail EP comes out on 4AD
years.p: The debut is on 4AD, the label that had launched Bauhaus.

years.h: 'There's Only One!' moves them to Beggars Banquet
years.p: Ash sings and plays guitar on the single, the first of their records on Beggars Banquet.

eras.title: Bauhaus ends, Haskins walks in
eras.text: Bauhaus played its last show in July 1983. Its drummer, Kevin Haskins, joined Ash and Campling, and the side project became a full-time trio.

years.h: Burning Skies makes No. 11 on the UK indie chart
years.p: The EP comes out on Situation Two, the Beggars imprint.

years.src: Wikipedia: Tones on Tail · Wikipedia: Pop
years.h: Kevin Haskins joins after Bauhaus splits
years.p: With Haskins on drums, Tones on Tail is a full band. In December the three record Pop across studios in England and Wales.

eras.title: Pop, white suits and 'Go!'
eras.text: One album, four singles and a tour of Britain and America, all in a year. The Bauhaus taste for the macabre was still there, but now people danced to it.

years.src: Wikipedia: Pop · Wikipedia: Tones on Tail
years.p: 'Performance' leads it in March. In North America it's called The Album Pop, and AllMusic's Ned Raggett later called it inspired and often unpredictable.

years.cap: Tones on Tail live at the Music Machine, Los Angeles, 1984
years.src: Torched: Fan questions · Wikipedia: Tones on Tail
years.p: Issued as a double A-side with 'Lions', 'Go!' was built on Glenn Campling's bass part and became the band's best-loved track. Canada got 'Go!' as its own single on Vertigo.
years.xp: Campling told Torched that 'Go!', 'OK, This Is the Pops' and 'Movement of Fear' were all built around his basslines. He played a Kramer eight-string bass through Boss chorus and fuzz pedals.

years.src: Post-Punk.com: Campling unearths live footage · Torched: Campling opens up
yt: Live at Night Moves, Glasgow, May 27, 1984
years.h: Bauhaus's old manager films the band at Night Moves, Glasgow
years.p: Ex-Bauhaus manager Graham Bentley shoots the set. Campling found the tape decades later and, in 2019, put it out with the desk audio.
years.xp: "Graham & family came to see us in Glasgow and decided to film the event," Campling said. Live footage of Tones on Tail is otherwise almost nonexistent.

years.cap: Flyer for Tones on Tail at the Music Machine, Los Angeles, 1984
years.h: A dozen US dates in white suits end in Detroit
years.p: The American run starts at San Francisco's I-Beam on October 8 and plays two nights at LA's Music Machine. The last show is at St. Andrew's Hall in Detroit.
Released after the tour, it closes the band's catalogue.

years.big: Ash didn't want to write the words alone
years.src: Torched: Fan questions · Torched: Campling opens up
years.h: Ash ends Tones on Tail to start Love and Rockets
years.p: Campling's account: Ash had trouble writing lyrics on his own, so he chose to work with [[David J|41225e9f-3b4c-4287-a778-165c65f04be9]] again. With Haskins, they became [[Love and Rockets|8cb3aa4a-3b4c-48b8-be0a-e57010fc1430]].
years.xp: Campling told Torched that Ash "had issues writing lyrics on his own" and decided to finish the band. Campling semi-retired from music to focus on family, and in 2011 started LoneStation with Mark Garner.

eras.title: Forty years to the next gig
eras.text: Beggars kept the records in print, and Ash and Haskins kept the songs alive in other bands. Then a Pasadena festival booked Tones on Tail itself.

years.p: Beggars Banquet compiles the band's records. Everything! followed in 1998, remastered, with a radio interview with Ash and Haskins.

years.cap: Poptone at the Regency Ballroom, San Francisco, June 2017
q: I'm very, very proud of that stuff.
years.src: Wikipedia: Tones on Tail · Slicing Up Eyeballs
years.h: Poptone puts Haskins's daughter on bass
years.p: Ash and Haskins form Poptone with Diva Dompé and play Bauhaus, Love and Rockets and Tones on Tail songs.
years.xp: In 2023 Ash told Slicing Up Eyeballs it's a shame people don't mention Tones on Tail more often, and credited Poptone with bringing the songs back.

years.src: Post-Punk.com: Tones on Tail at Cruel World · setlist.fm · Wikipedia: Tones on Tail
years.h: Tones on Tail plays Cruel World, its first show since 1984
years.p: Dompé stands in for Campling, who gave his blessing to use the name. The ten-song set opens with 'Heartbreak Hotel' and closes with 'Go!' and 'There's Only One'.
years.xp: Campling said that after a long talk with Ash, "we agreed that there were too many obstacles to overcome" for him to play. Post-Punk.com noted Ash skipped the white suit of 1984 for the most gothic outfit he could find.
